purpose: Measure routing correctness, the stock installed journey, compression, and real product batching before authorizing optional convenience infrastructure.

trial_policy.cache_state: unavailable unless a trial records an enforceable cold/warm mechanism

workflows.historical_full_serial: A_full_serial: full skill guidance, serial read-only lanes, model synthesis
workflows.historical_compressed_serial: B_compressed_serial: compressed family guidance, serial read-only lanes, model synthesis
workflows.historical_compressed_parallel: C_compressed_parallel: compressed family guidance, parallel read-only lanes, model synthesis
workflows.product_launcher_serial: actual code-health family launcher in serial mode with deterministic synthesis
workflows.product_launcher_parallel: actual code-health family launcher in parallel mode with deterministic synthesis

representative_router_journeys: installed which-shape -> adapt-project -> final configuration/evidence artifact
installed which-skill -> supported language skill -> final artifact/native verification boundary
installed which-cleanup -> eligible bounded closeout -> explicit findings or no-op

correctness.observation: frozen route gates plus exact semantic projection and final-artifact rubric

completion.observation: all required final artifacts and terminal statuses

true_root_wall_time_ms.observation: one monotonic timer around the complete condition subprocess; modeled call sums are reported separately

observable_model_tokens.observation: provider input_tokens + output_tokens + reasoning_output_tokens; cached_input_tokens is a reported subset, not added again

controlled_context_utf8_bytes.observation: UTF-8 byte length of explicitly recorded task, guidance, command, and synthesis-context blobs injected into calls

repeated_context_utf8_bytes.observation: group recorded context blobs by SHA-256 and sum (occurrences - 1) * blob_utf8_bytes for each hash

scanner_invocations.observation: count top-level skill/scanner commands separately from native compiler, test, or language-server commands

native_tool_invocations.observation: count nested compiler, test, package-manager, or language-server commands only when event-instrumented

human_interventions.observation: ordered events with kind, condition, reason, action, and elapsed_ms

recoverable_failures.observation: ordered events with command, symptom, documented_repair, repair_sufficient, and elapsed_ms

cache_state.observation: cold, warm, or unavailable with the enforcement mechanism or limitation

correctness_gates: 100% of clear corpus cases route as frozen
every ambiguous case stays within its allowed set or asks a discriminating question
zero heavy false positives on direct/no-skill cases
every selected closure is exact, exists, and matches capability truth
serial and parallel product projections are semantically identical
all final artifacts, native checks, source-preservation, and failure-honesty rubrics pass

p9_adoption_threshold.performance: at least 20% median true-root wall-time reduction or 30% controlled-context reduction
p9_adoption_threshold.correctness: all P8 correctness gates remain green

decision: Use the completed historical run for model/token evidence and run the actual product launcher without new model calls. Do not build a coordinator, updater, telemetry service, or dependency DAG unless a measured user journey independently justifies it.
